title: $expand values are policed, and two valid ones are refused here
claim: A value outside the documented set is refused with INVALID_PARAMETER and a hint listing every valid value. Two values inside the set are still refused in a My Campaign context: `scores` with 403 and `pollingLocation` with 400.

entries.text: An invented section. The hint in the refusal is the authoritative list.

errors.text: 'frisbees' is not a valid argument for the '$expand' parameter
errors.hint: The only valid expand sections are: 'contributionHistory', 'addresses', 'phones', 'emails', 'codes', 'customFields', 'externalIds', 'preferences', 'recordedAddresses', 'reportedDemographics', 'suppressions', 'cases', 'customProperties', 'districts', 'electionRecords', 'membershipStatuses', 'notes', 'organizationRoles', 'scores', 'disclosureFieldValues', 'primaryContact', 'pollingLocation', 'biography'

entries.text: `scores` is in the valid set, but this context is refused it outright.
`pollingLocation` is also in the set, and also refused — but as a 400.

errors.text: May not request 'pollingLocation' in this context
